measurement.timing: CUDA events around one call on the caller's stream; the graph arm replays graph_ops collectives per call and reports per-collective time
measurement.summary: *_us is the median over a rank's samples, then the maximum over ranks (slowest rank)
measurement.ratio_direction: ratio_nccl_over_roce_* = nccl_us / roce_*_us; above 1 means RoCEnante is faster
measurement.ordering: arms run in interleaved blocks, order reversed on odd blocks; the executed order is recorded per row
measurement.target_path: RoceOneshotAllReduce.all_reduce / all_gather, the entry points the vLLM adapter dispatches to; graph replay is the decode path
